completion_rule: An operation becomes COMPLETE only when its CoreSpec law, program encoding, bounded verification, reference evaluation, VM, AOT, source producer, differential evidence, and deletion of every legacy semantic dependency from the canonical pipeline are complete in one vertical slice.

precut_route_policy.state_during_w7: single frozen current product; canonical implementation remains off-product
precut_route_policy.cutover: one atomic product-reachability change with no fallback or hidden executor

core_spec_stage.note: Operation rows advance only by complete W7 vertical slices. Twelve scalar/control/sealed-call rows are COMPLETE_W7_WAVE1; aggregate construct/project/update and all three named record-variant operations are COMPLETE_W7_WAVE2; owner move/drop and local place load/store are COMPLETE_W7_WAVE3_SLICE2; explicit copy and the monotone ownership-domain proof are COMPLETE_W7_WAVE3_SLICE3; sealed invoke and typed error publication are COMPLETE_W7_WAVE3_SLICE4; trap and profile query remain frozen for their owning waves.

program_format_stage.note: W2 owns canonical bytes and bounded structural decode. W3 owns typed admission; executor coverage remains frozen for W5-W7.

semantic_admission_stage.note: All 28 registered operations have bounded verification and independent reference evaluation. Explicit owner copy, affine ownership-domain proof, sealed invoke, and typed error publication are active; panic, coroutine, import, and boundary surfaces fail closed until their owning slices activate them.

vm_stage.note: All 28 registered operations execute in the independent typed VM and match the reference evaluator. Private fixed rows are disposable runtime views, not a second public bytecode or distribution format.

aot_stage.native_identity: ExecutionId + BackendId + ToolchainId + OptimizationPolicyId + native bytes
aot_stage.note: All 28 registered operations lower through an independently verified BackendIR into portable C11. The pure native fixture links no VM, compiler, program loader, or AOT toolchain.
